Package com.bilt.pos.platform

Class BiltCredentials

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.platform.BiltCredentials
public final class BiltCredentials extends Object
Credentials that identify an integrator to the Bilt platform.

The only grant issued today is OAuth 2.0 client credentials, created with clientCredentials(String, String). The SDK exchanges the pair for short-lived access tokens on the integrator's behalf; neither the pair nor the tokens are ever exposed to widgets, surfaces or callbacks.

The secret is held as a char[] rather than a String. A String would be interned in the heap for the lifetime of the process and printed by any careless toString(), log statement or debugger watch; a char[] prints as an opaque array reference and can be zeroed if a caller ever needs to. toString() redacts the secret and no exception raised by this package carries it. Building the HTTP Authorization header necessarily creates a transient String; that is confined to the moment the token request is sent.

Other grant types (for example a pre-issued token, or a delegated grant for a hosted surface) would appear as further factories on this class; the BiltCredentials.Kind enum is where the client dispatches on them. It is package-private on purpose so that no public commitment is made to grants that do not exist yet.
